<!-- Included via revealjs `include-after-body` from lectures/*.qmd (depth 1: ../js, ../index.html). -->
<!-- Grouped in one flex toolbar (bottom-left) rather than each being its own
     independently-positioned fixed element — bottom-right is already busy
     with Reveal's own slide-number/controls, and flex layout means the two
     buttons never overlap regardless of how wide either one renders. -->
<div class="lecture-toolbar">
  <a class="lecture-home-link" href="../index.html">← Course Home</a>
</div>
<script src="../js/embed-bridge.js"></script>
<script src="../js/text-to-speech.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var tries = 0;
  var iv = setInterval(function () {
    tries++;
    if (window.Reveal && typeof window.Reveal.isReady === "function" && window.Reveal.isReady()) {
      clearInterval(iv);
      EmbedBridge.parentInit();
      initReadAloud();
      initCaptionFit();
      initStudentNotes();
    } else if (tries > 100) {
      clearInterval(iv);
    }
  }, 100);

  // A standalone slide image gets Reveal's r-stretch treatment: Reveal's JS
  // sizes the <img> (inline width/height) to fill the space left on the
  // slide, but the caption Quarto puts after it is an ordinary full-width
  // paragraph, so it ends up much wider than the figure it describes. CSS
  // alone can't follow a JS-computed width, so watch each stretched image and
  // give its caption the same width. ResizeObserver covers every case at once
  // (initial lazy load, window resize, a hidden slide becoming visible).
  // Auto-animate slides are skipped so the morph pairs stay untouched.
  function initCaptionFit() {
    if (!window.ResizeObserver) return;
    var imgs = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal .slides section img.r-stretch");
    imgs.forEach(function (img) {
      var cap = img.nextElementSibling;
      if (!cap || !cap.classList.contains("caption")) return;
      var section = img.closest("section");
      if (section && section.hasAttribute("data-auto-animate")) return;
      new ResizeObserver(function () {
        var w = img.offsetWidth;
        if (!w) return; // not laid out yet (hidden slide / image still loading)
        cap.style.width = w + "px";
        cap.style.marginLeft = "auto";
        cap.style.marginRight = "auto";
      }).observe(img);
    });
  }

  // ---- Student notes -------------------------------------------------------
  // A "My notes" panel for the slide the student is on. Notes are saved in this
  // browser only (localStorage): nothing is sent anywhere, so the site still
  // collects nothing. They survive reloads on the same device and browser, but
  // not a different device, a private window, or cleared site data. "Download"
  // saves every note, in slide order, as a text file the student keeps.
  function initStudentNotes() {
    var KEY = "phm801-notes:" + location.pathname;
    var store = {}, canSave = true;
    try { store = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || "{}") || {}; } catch (e) { canSave = false; store = {}; }
    var SAVED = "Saved on this device only.";
    var NOSAVE = "This browser is not letting the page save notes. Use Download to keep them.";
    function persist() {
      try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(store)); canSave = true; } catch (e) { canSave = false; }
      status.textContent = canSave ? SAVED : NOSAVE;
    }
    function slideId(s) { return s.id || ("slide-" + Array.prototype.indexOf.call(s.parentNode.children, s)); }
    function slideTitle(s) { var h = s.querySelector("h1, h2"); return h ? h.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() : "Slide"; }

    var btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button"; btn.className = "lecture-notes-btn";
    btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false"); btn.setAttribute("aria-controls", "student-notes-panel");
    btn.textContent = "✎ My notes";

    var panel = document.createElement("section");
    panel.id = "student-notes-panel"; panel.className = "student-notes"; panel.hidden = true;
    panel.setAttribute("aria-label", "My notes");
    var head = document.createElement("p"); head.className = "student-notes__title";
    var area = document.createElement("textarea");
    area.className = "student-notes__text"; area.rows = 7;
    area.setAttribute("aria-label", "Your notes for this slide");
    area.placeholder = "Type your notes for this slide here.";
    var status = document.createElement("p"); status.className = "student-notes__status";
    var row = document.createElement("div"); row.className = "student-notes__actions";
    var dl = document.createElement("button"); dl.type = "button"; dl.textContent = "Download all my notes";
    var clr = document.createElement("button"); clr.type = "button"; clr.textContent = "Delete all my notes";
    var close = document.createElement("button"); close.type = "button"; close.textContent = "Close";
    row.append(dl, clr, close);
    panel.append(head, area, status, row);
    document.body.appendChild(panel);
    document.querySelector(".lecture-toolbar").appendChild(btn);

    var current = null;
    function mark() { btn.classList.toggle("has-note", !!(current && store[current])); }
    function show() {
      var s = Reveal.getCurrentSlide(); if (!s) return;
      current = slideId(s);
      head.textContent = "Notes: " + slideTitle(s);
      area.value = store[current] || "";
      status.textContent = canSave ? SAVED : NOSAVE;
      mark();
    }
    area.addEventListener("input", function () {
      if (!current) return;
      if (area.value.trim()) store[current] = area.value; else delete store[current];
      persist(); mark();
    });
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var open = panel.hidden; panel.hidden = !open;
      btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      if (open) { show(); area.focus(); }
    });
    close.addEventListener("click", function () { panel.hidden = true; btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false"); btn.focus(); });
    panel.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape") { e.stopPropagation(); close.click(); } });
    Reveal.on("slidechanged", show);
    dl.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var out = [document.title, "My notes", ""];
      var any = false;
      Reveal.getSlides().forEach(function (s) {
        var n = store[slideId(s)];
        if (n && n.trim()) { any = true; out.push("## " + slideTitle(s), n.trim(), ""); }
      });
      if (!any) { status.textContent = "You have not written any notes yet."; return; }
      var name = (location.pathname.split("/").pop() || "lecture").replace(/\.html$/, "");
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([out.join("\n")], { type: "text/plain" }));
      a.download = "phm801-notes-" + name + ".txt";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 1000);
    });
    clr.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (!Object.keys(store).length) { status.textContent = "There are no notes to delete."; return; }
      if (!window.confirm("Delete every note you have written for this lecture? This cannot be undone.")) return;
      store = {}; persist(); show();
    });
    show();
  }

  function getSlideText(section) {
    if (!section) return "";
    var clone = section.cloneNode(true);
    var strip = clone.querySelectorAll("button, iframe, .activity-embed-controls, aside.notes, .read-aloud-btn");
    for (var i = 0; i < strip.length; i++) strip[i].remove();
    return clone.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  }

  function initReadAloud() {
    if (!window.TextToSpeech) return;
    var btn = TextToSpeech.createReadAloudButton(
      function () { return getSlideText(Reveal.getCurrentSlide()); },
      { label: "🔊 Read this slide", className: "lecture-read-aloud-btn" }
    );
    if (!btn) return; // no speech synthesis support in this browser
    document.querySelector(".lecture-toolbar").appendChild(btn);
    // Don't keep reading a slide the presenter has already navigated away from.
    Reveal.on("slidechanged", function () { TextToSpeech.stop(); });
  }
})();
</script>
